additional_results_text: AZT1D’s lowest point-estimate MAEs were 30 minutes: Stack, 15.06 mg/dL; 60 minutes: BiLSTMTransformer, 24.33 mg/dL; 90 minutes: BiLSTMTransformer, 30.34 mg/dL. Chronos-2 MAE on ddatshr was 19.70/34.33/45.04 mg/dL. Three-validator RF HR-minus-CGM differences on ddatshr were +0.17/+0.09/+0.05 mg/dL. Chronos-2 MAE on diadata was 23.85/36.23/45.37 mg/dL. Three-validator RF HR-minus-CGM differences on diadata were +0.21/+0.15/+0.10 mg/dL. These point estimates do not establish universal architecture superiority or HR equivalence. The supplementary tables retain all seeds, participant errors, glycemic ranges, Clarke zones and paired descriptive intervals.
